title: The Hidden Treasure and the Pearl
reflectionText: Two men, two finds — a treasure in a field, and a single perfect pearl. Neither one hesitates. They sell everything they have, and the one who found the treasure does it in joy. The kingdom is pictured not as a burden to take up but as a find worth more than all a person owns. What would you gladly let go of if you found something worth more than the rest?
